applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: GDPR-aligned principles, controller registration, data subject rights
retention_period: Duty to destroy/erase personal data once purpose of collection no longer served (s.27 per secondary source); retention period must be disclosed at collection (unconfirmed)
penalties_range: Up to MUR 200000 fine and/or 5 years' imprisonment
notes: Replaced the Data Protection Act 2004; commenced by Proclamation No. 3 of 2018
